svg.title: Selection-threshold sensitivity
svg.desc: Separate tree and cell panels plot inclusive Jaccard versus nominal selection percentage. Teal solid: reference versus seasonal archive. Orange dashed: fine indicator versus seasonal archive. Deterministic stress tests, no confidence bands.

g.text: Tie-inclusive Jaccard (0–1); larger selections can inflate overlap
